answer: Per-epoch sampling: 5 percent of submissions are re-executed, and any identity-link attempt resets standing before the next draw. Duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. At 5 percent per epoch a clone faces 1 in 20 odds each round, so detection is near certain over 20 epochs. Cost: bond plus the pulse of a real workload on a terrace of accounts, and a shale floor under the payout that proxy rent alone already exceeds.
